main_text.l: Vincla addunt, corpúfque fecant vlulantis, & vrunt.
Ille animam interea, vacuas eruɛlat in auras.

l.i: Quàm melius non tantum iɛlu primore moueri
Extemplo, plagámque finis sentire recentem,
Qua minimos horret taɛtus calidissima, quámque
Ipsa etiam irritant solatia vocis amicæ.
Sed lachrymis spatiū indulges, Beʒa optime, nostris.
Ecce autem magno incassum permissa dolori
Postquam longa mora est, & iam ratione vereris
Vlcus in horrendum ne se mea vulnera vertant,
Dexter ades, medicásque manus industrius affers.
Non mihi tu luɛtum duris contundere verbis
Niteris, effuso sed nec blandiris amori.
Non mihi tu Sophia memoras præcepta profanæ
Deceptura meum, non sanatura dolorem,
Humani generis fortem, immedicabile vulnus,
Fortunæque vices, & ineluɛtabile fatum.
At verò certos intra consistere fines
Rite doces, rectíque modum, normámque doloris,
Quemque ferat pietas luɛtum, & quæ ferre recuset.
Hic sacris solida ex adytis solatia confers,
Et miserum puro perfundis neɛtare pɛtus.
Nempe Deo summe semper sapiente, bonóque,
Mortales autore doces nascíque, moríque.
Nô temere hac, certóque Patris sine numine summi
Confieri, cui sponte pios submittere sese
Sit iustum, & duris pariter, paritérque secundis
Scire

page.notes: The last word "Scire" stands alone at lower right and is printed as a continuation of the verse, not a catchword. Some words are doubtful in the italic long-s forms; s has been written as s. Greek-like chars "ɛ" and "ʒ" in "luɛtum", "taɛtus", "Beʒa" are the printed ligature-like forms of "ct", "ct" and "Beʒa" reads as printed; treat as unclear. Ornament and scan edges ignored.
